text:
sam: heads up — batch publish to us-east-2 just finished and we're seeing a subset of images without provenance metadata. i'm holding the k8s deploy window until we confirm.

deploy-bot: publish-job #4821 -> partially failed. 7/42 images published, 35 attestation checks skipped, see logs: https://ci.internal/reports/4821

eva: can you paste the error from the publish job? quick grep from the log showed "missing attestation" for some manifests.

sam: paste from logs:
```
ERROR: ecr-publish: manifest upload succeeded but provenance attestation missing for image redwood/app:v2.3.0-20260320
ERROR: ecr-publish: attestation step exit code 1 -> timeout waiting for signer service
```

mike: signer timeouts during peak - we had a backlog of background uploads. publish jobs retried but some races caused publisher A to push manifest then publisher B to overwrite tag with same tag pointing to different digest before attestation finished.

jen: ah — tag collision + attestation ordering. retagging all affected images with ephemeral build ids will be safest. we should avoid retagging to non-digest stable tags in the same change window.

release-manager: agree with hold. customers on Dedicated might be sensitive; we should update release notes and the status page with a short blurb. also schedule a short change window for retag/backfill.

sam: proposal: hold deploy, move forward with a 30m change window at 11:30 PT to
- retag affected images as v2.3.0+build.<shortsha>
- publish attestations after signer confirms
- push updated image pins to the k8s manifests (canary only first)

mike: i'll own retagging + pushing attestations. jen can do the manifest updates and canary rollout. pinging @jen

jen: ack. i'll prepare a small canary job that points to the new tags and watch health for 15m before rolling the rest. will add healthcheck thresholds to the rollout.

eva: who will backfill the release notes? i can draft the note:
- short incident blurb: "Image publish partially failed due to attestation timeouts; affected images were retagged and republished. Deployment delayed ~45 minutes."

release-manager: thanks, eva. add an internal note for Sales + Support saying we held the change window and why (attestation ordering). keep customer-facing wording generic.

sam: operational checklist for the window:
1) identify affected digests: `jq '.results[] | select(.attestation==false) | .image' publish-report.json`
2) for each digest: `docker tag <digest> redwood/app:v2.3.0+build.<shortsha>`
3) `aws ecr put-image --repository redwood/app --image-manifest file://manifest.json --image-tag v2.3.0+build.<shortsha>`
4) once signer confirms, update manifest kustomize overlay and trigger canary deploy

mike: note: use queuing to avoid concurrent tag overwrite. i'll serialize retags with a small sleep and check the signer status API between each.

jen: i'll prepare the k8s PR with the new image pins and mark it for manual merge at rollout time.

sam: estimate: retag + attestation backfill ~20-30m, canary 15m, then full rollout if clean. total ~60m worst-case. but we'll aim for 30-45m.

deploy-bot: deploy window locked by @sam. change window reserved 2026-03-20T11:30:00-07:00 -> 2026-03-20T12:15:00-07:00

eva: i posted a short status in #status-page-drafts and emailed support a one-paragraph note. linking: https://docs.internal/releases/notes/draft-1859102345

mike: starting a dry-run on a single affected image now to validate signer flow. will report back in ~5m.

jen: prepping canary manifests and health probes. will be on standby.

sam: thanks everyone. if any image can't be attested within the window we'll fallback to rebuilding from CI and republishing with new digest. last resort is postponing the release to tomorrow morning.

mike: dry-run succeeded for the sample image. signer confirmed and attestation present. proceeding with batch retag now. will post progress.

sam: copy. keep messages short in this thread; escalate to #incidents only if we need cross-team help. :thumbsup:
